title: Ruinous Manipulations
subtitle: Mortem — blood remembers death
text: Ruinous blood has witnessed too much dying. Hemorrhage (QUICK) opens the nearest enemy's vessels for twelve seconds of Blood Loss and seeds Necrosis. Insatiable Hunger (QUICK) bites and curses a target's recovery, and Grave Debt (QUICK) marks a debt that refunds blood if death claims it. Exsanguinate (QUICK) executes a badly wounded blood-bearing enemy and restores blood only on a kill. Fruiting Contagion (QUICK) wracks every enemy already carrying Necrosis and spreads the rot to those close by. Funeral Bell (CHARGED) tolls a deathly pulse that spends Necrosis early. Blackhearted (PASSIVE) turns Wither harm into recovery until it ruptures. Carrion Communion (CONTINUOUS) drains afflicted enemies on R. Sculpting, Absorption: held toward rotten flesh, bones, skulls or a bone block it draws Mortem Temper and a little health from the dead, never blood. Lignum Mortis (CONTINUOUS) threads rot through joined wood and fungus and fells it, by Projection or on R. Canopy Mortis (CONTINUOUS) carries it through touching leaves and Worked Lignum (CONTINUOUS) through planks; see Lignum Mortis. Bloom of Rot (QUICK) is Putriciel's Canon Memory: their rot erupts through every body near you, yours included. Conjure Sickle calls Vesper's refusal into a Living Sickle.
